title: City Rollout Sequence
description: A master tour-poster sequence that establishes one performer-led poster grammar and adapts it into city-specific rollout variants.
creative_direction: The first image defines a hero tour-poster composition with one performer, one spotlight architecture, and one date-block language rendered as non-readable graphic modules. The following images preserve the same identity and hierarchy while shifting venue mood and environmental cues.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-main-tour-poster first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-arena-night-variant, 03-theater-velvet-variant, 04-open-air-dusk-variant. Queue may run 02-arena-night-variant, 03-theater-velvet-variant, 04-open-air-dusk-variant concurrently after 01-reference-main-tour-poster is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
